# Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 grammar (https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html), read by the
# tests of both parsers: racking-server's types::Version and rack's update::version.
# `ok V` must parse, `bad V` must not; `<empty>` stands for the empty string.
ok 0.1.0
ok 1.2.3
ok 10.20.30
